description: Rotate 90/180/270 degrees and flip, in the browser.

faqs.a: The canvas is re-rendered at the image's full original resolution, then exported as a PNG — no quality is lost in the rotation itself.
Yes — rotate and flip can be combined freely. Each click updates the preview, and the download applies all of them at once.
faqs.q: Can I rotate and flip at the same time?

faqs.a: It is always exported as PNG, which is lossless. The original file is never modified.

howto: Drop an image onto the dropzone or click to browse.
Click rotate left/right and flip horizontal/vertical as needed.
Download the result as a PNG.
title: Image Rotate & Flip
